curation_note: Prepared inputs are curated subsets of one later structural canonical capture per scenario. Each included CanonicalObservation is copied verbatim; no evidence is merged across captures and no diagnosis is embedded.
artifact_path_convention: Artifact paths are relative to the clean project root.
budget_method: Complete frozen build_generator_request serialized bytes; estimated tokens = ceil(bytes / 4); selected-request guard = 7000 estimated input tokens.
